name: cursor-skill-studio
description: Cursor pack covering the full skill lifecycle: writing, maintaining, and auditing skills and packs. Successor to cursor-skill-creator (renamed). Ships skill-studio-write (greenfield authoring, distillation, pack scaffolding, external intake, Claude-plugin adaptation, eval loop) and skill-studio-audit (single-skill compliance audit, improvement recommendations, installed portfolio audit, deep repo-first-party overlap audit), the legacy cursor-skill-creator-workflow during deprecation, authoring helper subagents, and audit subagents (overlap clusterer, architecture checker, consolidation advisor). The maintain workflow lands in the next PR per ADR-0005.
author: felipeblassioli

lite.description: Installs the bundled authoring workflow, helper subagents, and audit subagents (overlap clusterer, architecture checker, consolidation advisor) without persistent project rules.

strict.description: Same as lite plus project-only guidance for disciplined intake, decomposition, and evaluation loops when authoring or auditing packs and bundled skills.

notes: Strict installs add persistent project guidance for adapting source material into bundled skills and packs.
User installs skip rules because Cursor user rules are managed in settings rather than a ~/.cursor/rules directory.
Pack-scoped: not listed in skill-registry.json. Invoke explicitly via /skill-studio-write.
Consolidates writing-cursor-skills, create-skill-from-refs, create-cursor-pack-from-refs, external-skill-intake, and claude-plugin-to-cursor-pack per ADR-0005.
Pack-scoped: not listed in skill-registry.json. Invoke explicitly via /skill-studio-audit.
Consolidates audit-skill-for-cursor, improving-agent-artifacts, and the packs/skill-consistency-auditor bundled workflow per ADR-0005.
Deprecated: superseded by skill-studio-write in 0.4.0. Kept here for one release to avoid breaking existing installs; removal target is 0.5.0 per ADR-0005.
